title: Sell or Trade Your Boat, Kayak or Sailboat
seo_title: Sell or Trade Your Boat or Kayak | Ottawa, IL
seo_description: Ready to sell or trade your boat, kayak or sailboat? Tell Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL about it using the form below or call 815.433.2200.
body_html:
Ready to sell or trade your boat, kayak or sailboat? Quest Watersports, next to Heritage Harbor on the Illinois River in Ottawa, IL, can help. Fill out the form below, or call us at 815.433.2200.

What to Include

The more you tell us, the faster we can get back to you.

Boats

  • Year, make, model and length
  • Engine make, horsepower and hours
  • Trailer included or not
  • Condition, upgrades and any known issues
  • Where the boat is located
  • Your asking price, or whether you are interested in a trade

Kayaks and Paddleboards

  • Year, make and model (for example Hobie or Old Town)
  • Accessories included, such as drive, paddles, seat, rudder or rigging
  • Condition and any repairs

Sailboats

  • Year, make and model, such as a Hobie sailboat
  • Sails, trailer and extras included
  • Condition and any repairs

Photos Help

Add a few clear photos if you can. If you are not sure what to say, just send what you know and we will follow up with questions.

Looking for your next boat? See boats for sale, kayaks and paddleboards, or Hobie sailboats. Need financing? See financing options.
